definitions.M_G: max{b : v_p(b!) < G}; least cutoff with pi_b(x) == 0 mod p^G for all x in Z_p and all b > M_G (Lemma 1 of writeup)
definitions.N_G(x): #{B subset [1,M_G] : p^G | 1 + sum_{b in B} pi_b(x)}, exact, depends on x mod p^G
definitions.delta_G(2): Haar measure of {x in Z_2 : g_2(x) >= G}; Monte Carlo rows are estimates with binomial standard errors
definitions.c_p: max over units xi mod p of prod_{r=0}^{p-1} |cos(pi xi r!/p)|
definitions.Lunit(p,i): sum over units xi mod p^i of prod_{u<p} |cos(pi xi e_u / p^i)|, e_u = (-1)^u (p-1)!/u!
definitions.I_p: int_0^1 prod_u |cos(pi e_u theta)| dtheta (Gauss-Legendre on unit pieces; exact structure, double precision)
